desc: Sheldon, in a beige jacket, and Leonard sit in the car, which suddenly stops, and Sheldon, with eyes wide open, looks at Leonard.
A shot of a woman looking through a telescope, standing next to smiling Raj, seen through a window.
Penny bursts out laughing with mouth wide open, while sitting at the dinner table with salad in front of a smiling Leonard.
Raj, while holding a beer bottle, reaches out and slaps Leonard on the back while he eats his food.
Howard, in orange plaid shirt, reach out a taps couple of times, Bernadette on the laps, next to food that she is holding.
Raj, in an orange apron, is serving  a bowl of salad to Lucy and Amy who are sitting at the table talking.
Lucy puts aside an orange napkin and rushes away from the table where Amy and Raj are sitting.
Penny, in a grocery store with Sheldon, grabs two bottles of vodka and puts them in a cart.
Penny, in a grocery store with Sheldon, grabs a six pack of beer from a cooler and puts it in a cart.
Penny grabs a bottle of white wine from a shelf in the store and looks at it while talking to Sheldon, then puts it back on the shelf.
Penny walks closer to the shelf with wine while talking to Sheldon, and puts two bottles of wine into the shopping cart.
Leonard, at a house party, pours a shot from a shaker and hands it to Bernadette.
Howard, at a house party, picks up a bottle of wine from the kitchen counter, pours himself a glass, and sets the bottle back down.
Raj, in a brown shirt, stands up from the couch, where he was sitting next to Amy, and puts his hands in his pockets.
Sheldon, in a green shirt with a tie, hits a fork against his glass of milk as a toast.
Raj, in a brown shirt, shows Howard something on his cell phone.
Bernadette, in red dress, walks up to upset Raj and Howard, looking at something on cell phone.
Sheldon, in a green shirt with a tie, lifts his glass of milk as a toast with everybody and drinks it.
Leonard and Penny both unbuckle their seat belts, while sitting in a red car, and turn toward each other.
Sheldon, in the back seat, gestures with his thumb out the rear window to Penny behind the wheel.
Leonard picks up and then hands Penny a small gift in the car with Sheldon in the back seat.
Sheldon, in a grey shirt, taps the front seat where Leonard is sitting twice and leans forward toward him.
Sheldon puts his head out of the car window, then gives a thumbs up while Penny and Leonard are kissing and hugging in the car.
Penny scoots closer on the couch, then leans over and hugs sad Raj on the couch with colorful patterned pillows.
Penny raises her head while hugging Raj on the couch with colorful patterned pillows and stops hugging him to look at him
Penny waves her hands over her face and hugs Raj, who starts to cry, on the couch with colorful patterned pillows.
Penny is pouring herself wine as she stands in the kitchen with Amy, Raj, and Bernadette, who is wearing a green sweater.
Penny looks uncomfortable at Amy and Bernadette, who are standing in front of Raj with glasses of wine, at the kitchen table.
Amy, in a blue sweater, takes a drink from her wine glass as Raj continues to talk, at the kitchen table.
Penny points at the bottle of wine, then Raj grabs and lifts his bottle of water, while Bernadette and Amy are around the kitchen table.
